Let
\[
B_N(a)=\sum_{k=0}^N\frac{(-1)^k\binom Nk}{k+a}.
\]
Using the beta integral,
\[
B_N(a)=\int_0^1 x^{a-1}(1-x)^N\,dx
=\frac{\Gamma(a)\Gamma(N+1)}{\Gamma(N+a+1)}.
\]
Also
\[
\sum_{k=0}^N\frac{(-1)^k\binom Nk}{(k+a)^2}
=-\frac{\partial}{\partial a}B_N(a)
=B_N(a)\bigl(\psi(N+a+1)-\psi(a)\bigr).
\]
Write
\[
L_N(a)=\psi(N+a+1)-\psi(a).
\]

Set \(L=\log n\), and write
\[
a=\frac{1+\delta}{L},\qquad \delta=aL-1.
\]
The solution satisfies \(|\delta|<1/10\).

Let
\[
X_1=B_n(a),\quad X_2=eB_{n^2}(a),\quad X_3=e^2B_{n^3}(a),\quad X_M=e^2B_{n^3+m_n}(a),
\]
where \(M=n^3+m_n\). The determinant condition is equality of two weighted averages:
\[
\frac{X_1L_n+X_2L_{n^2}+X_3L_{n^3}}{X_1+X_2+X_3}
=
\frac{X_1L_n+X_2L_{n^2}+X_ML_M}{X_1+X_2+X_M}.
\]
After cancellation this becomes
\[
\frac{X_3-X_M}{L_M-L_{n^3}}
=
\frac{(X_1+X_2+X_3)X_M}{X_1(L_{n^3}-L_n)+X_2(L_{n^3}-L_{n^2})}.
\]

Uniformly for \(|\delta|<1/10\),
\[
X_1=\Gamma(a)e^{-1}e^{-\delta}\left(1-\frac{a+a^2}{2n}+o\!\left(\frac1{nL}\right)\right),
\]
while
\[
X_2=\Gamma(a)e^{-1}e^{-2\delta}+o\!\left(\frac{\Gamma(a)}{nL}\right),\qquad
X_3=\Gamma(a)e^{-1}e^{-3\delta}+o\!\left(\frac{\Gamma(a)}{nL}\right).
\]
Also, since
\[
\frac{m_n}{n^3}=\frac{2}{3n}+O(n^{-3}),
\]
we have
\[
\frac{X_M}{X_3}=1-\frac{2a}{3n}+o\!\left(\frac1{nL}\right).
\]
For the digamma differences,
\[
L_{n^3}-L_n=2L-\frac{a+\frac12}{n}+o(n^{-1}),
\qquad
L_{n^3}-L_{n^2}=L+o(n^{-1}).
\]

Substituting these expansions into the determinant equation and expanding to first order gives
\[
1+\delta
=
1-\frac{2}{3}\delta-\frac{1}{3}\left(-\frac{a}{2n}\right)
+\frac{a+\frac12}{3nL}
-\frac{2a}{3n}
+o\!\left(\frac1{nL}\right).
\]
Since \(a=1/L+o(1/L)\), this simplifies to
\[
1+\delta
=
1-\frac{2}{3}\delta-\frac{1}{3nL}+o\!\left(\frac1{nL}\right).
\]
Hence
\[
\frac{5}{3}\delta=-\frac1{3nL}+o\!\left(\frac1{nL}\right),
\]
so
\[
\delta=-\frac1{5n\log n}+o\!\left(\frac1{n\log n}\right).
\]
Therefore
\[
n(\log n)^2(a_n\log n-1)
=n(\log n)^2\delta
=
-\frac15\log n+o(\log n)\to -\infty.
\]

\[
\boxed{-\infty}
\]
